svg.title: KokoGecko: BB84 on a Bloch sphere
svg.desc: A Bloch sphere drawn in horizontal scanlines above a fibre from Alice to Bob. Every half second Alice sends a BB84 photon in the state zero, one, plus or minus; the qubit vector precesses about the vertical axis, Bob measures in a random basis, and the raw key types out along the bottom: kept bits underlined, dropped bits struck through.
